amulets.name: Minor Aetheric Amulet
amulets.description: A small Aetherstone shard wrapped in copper wire. Protects against minor Aetheric interference.

amulets.name: Lightstone Amulet
amulets.description: Aether-powered amulet that emits a steady glow. Repels shadow-aligned creatures and casts a halo in dark places.

amulets.name: Mud Warden Amulet
amulets.description: Worn by Mud Warden patrols. Grants brief protection from the corrosive runoff of the Mud Seas.

amulets.name: Aetheric Diadem
amulets.description: A delicate diadem cored with refined Aetherstone. Sharpens the channeller's focus.

amulets.name: Whisperer's Charm
amulets.description: A small charm carved from Aether-treated bone. Calms animals and softens hostile NPCs slightly.
